newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian Industrial Gases in share split.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian Industrial Gases in share split.

text.p: Industrial Gases Nigeria Plc, a leading producer in industrial and medical gases, on Tuesday raised its issued shares to 131 million with a one-for-one scrip issue.
Shares were adjusted on Tuesday to reflect the new structure and the payment of a dividend of 60 kobo per share and closed at 7.30 naira compared with 15.20 on Monday.
The company, which also sells welding and medical equipment, posted an after-tax profit of 81 million naira for the year ended on September 30, 1996 against 51.6 million naira in 1995.
Turnover was 394 million naira, up from 305 million naira in the previous year.
Industrial Gases is 40 percent owned by Nigerians. British firm BOC Holdings own the rest.
